newsitem.title: UK: Kier shares set debut premium.
newsitem.headline: Kier shares set debut premium.

text.p: Shares in contracting and house building group Kier Group Plc set an 8.5 percent premium on their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange on Thursday.
By 1516 GMT, the stock was trading at 184-1/2p. The shares were placed at 170p, valuing the group at 53.8 million sterling.
"It's been reasonably well received and there's reasonable ongoing interest," said John Messenger, analyst at the company's broker NatWest Securities.
"It has a good track record and a good cash position which should help fuel reasonable growth in the business."
Kier chairman Colin Busby was also upbeat about the issue. "We're very pleased with it," he said.
